purpose: Provide an agent-facing operational handoff for discovering and invoking the installed GVE macro surface without relying on implementation internals.

public_cli.rule: Treat macro-list and macro-schema as the authoritative public discovery surface. Do not infer unsupported parameters, hidden workflow steps, or implementation behavior from source code when constructing a request.

steps.requirement: Select only a macro identity returned by this command.
Construct parameters only from the returned public schema. Unknown or unsupported fields must not be invented.
Use schema_version 1 and a closed header.repository expectation object containing only applicable identity, branch, and head guards.
Return or upload the machine-readable result before authorizing or constructing the next mutating operation.

repository_expectations.branch: optional exact active local branch guard
repository_expectations.head: optional exact local HEAD guard

request_envelope.rule: Repository expectation fields are guards only. They do not grant filesystem, Git remote, process, or GitHub authority.

current_fs002_macros.note: This list is informational only. The agent must still run gve macro-list and gve macro-schema at operation time because the installed public introspection surface is authoritative.

discover: Use gve macro-schema discover to learn the maintained observation set.
issue: Supports only schema-admitted read, create, and modify operations.
Requires authenticated GitHub CLI authority available to GVE.
pr: Supports only schema-admitted read, create, and modify operations.
Requires authenticated GitHub CLI authority available to GVE.
modify: Operates on the active local branch; FS-002 does not create or switch the local working branch.
The local working branch must therefore already exist and be active before invoking modify.
Publication uses the product-maintained origin remote and normal non-force push semantics.
Validation defaults to the repository-root scripts/validate entry point.
Use the live schema to determine the exact admitted change, dirty-state, validation, and remote-branch parameters.

result_handling.success_rule: Do not infer success from terminal output alone. Inspect the result JSON and require top-level status == "success".
result_handling.failure_rule: On failure, stop the workflow, preserve unrelated user work, inspect the returned error/task evidence, and do not proceed to the next mutation.

safety_and_authority: Do not force-push or rewrite history.
Do not bypass GVE macro execution with direct GitHub or Git mutation when the requested operation is available through the macro surface.
Do not invent macro parameters or task identities.
Do not treat repository context, remotes, paths, or credentials as authority by themselves.
Preserve unrelated user work and stop on expectation, validation, authority, or remote-race failures.

relationship_to_script_transfer.distinction: script-transfer-handoff governs standalone web-to-local repository transfer scripts. This handoff governs direct use of the installed GVE macro CLI.
